cards.front: Complete the rule: Do not pass on a two-lane road at.
cards.back: Do not pass on a two-lane road at or near a hill, curve or obstruction that blocks the view of potentially hazardous oncoming vehicles.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Passing within one hundred feet of an.
cards.back: Passing within one hundred feet of an intersection is prohibited unless traffic-control devices indicate otherwise.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Passing within one hundred feet of a railroad.
cards.back: Passing within one hundred feet of a railroad crossing is prohibited unless traffic-control devices indicate otherwise.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Do not pass within one hundred feet of.
cards.back: Do not pass within one hundred feet of a bridge or tunnel when the view is obstructed.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Do not overtake a school bus.
cards.back: Do not overtake a school bus stopped to load or unload passengers.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Do not pass a vehicle that has stopped.
cards.back: Do not pass a vehicle that has stopped ahead at a marked or unmarked crosswalk to let a pedestrian cross.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A pass that requires leaving.
cards.back: A pass that requires leaving the pavement or roadway is prohibited.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Pass only when the maneuver will not interfere.
cards.back: Pass only when the maneuver will not interfere with oncoming traffic or the vehicle being overtaken.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Wait to pass until certain there.
cards.back: Wait to pass until certain there is enough time to complete it safely.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Before returning to the original lane after a.
cards.back: Before returning to the original lane after a pass, signal and wait until the overtaken vehicle is visible in the rear-view mirror.

cards.front: Complete the rule: If a pass cannot be completed safely after.
cards.back: If a pass cannot be completed safely after it begins, fall back and wait for another opening.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Passing signs and pavement markings identify prohibited or.
cards.back: Passing signs and pavement markings identify prohibited or unsafe locations, but the driver must still determine whether a pass is safe.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A passenger vehicle or pickup that is not.
cards.back: A passenger vehicle or pickup that is not towing may pass a vehicle traveling below the posted limit on a two-lane road posted at least fifty-five miles an hour by exceeding that limit by at most fifteen miles an hour outside a work zone, then returning to the right lane and the posted limit as soon as practicable.

cards.front: Complete the rule: On a two-lane two-way road, passing on the.
cards.back: On a two-lane two-way road, passing on the right is allowed only when the vehicle ahead signals a left turn and the move is safe without leaving the roadway.

cards.front: Complete the rule: On a one-way or multilane street with at.
cards.back: On a one-way or multilane street with at least two lanes in the driver's direction, passing on the right is allowed only if safe and without leaving the roadway.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Before moving left to pass, check mirrors and.
cards.back: Before moving left to pass, check mirrors and blind spots for another vehicle that may already be trying to pass.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Signal left before moving into.
cards.back: Signal left before moving into the left lane to pass.

cards.front: Complete the rule: After overtaking, wait until the passed vehicle appears.
cards.back: After overtaking, wait until the passed vehicle appears in the rear-view mirror, then signal right before returning to the right lane.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Use the horn if the vehicle being.
cards.back: Use the horn if the vehicle being passed starts drifting toward the passing vehicle.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Finish a pass before reaching a point.
cards.back: Finish a pass before reaching a point within two hundred feet of oncoming traffic.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Complete a pass before entering a No.
cards.back: Complete a pass before entering a No Passing zone identified by signs or pavement markings.

cards.front: Complete the rule: When another vehicle passes, move toward the right.
cards.back: When another vehicle passes, move toward the right side of the current lane to provide more room and a better view ahead.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Do not accelerate while being passed.
cards.back: Do not accelerate while being passed; keep a steady speed or reduce it.

cards.front: Complete the rule: While being passed, watch for the other driver's.
cards.back: While being passed, watch for the other driver's misjudgment because a quick response can reduce crash risk.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Do not join a funeral procession or drive.
cards.back: Do not join a funeral procession or drive between its vehicles unless a police officer authorizes it.

cards.front: Complete the rule: On a multilane highway, do not pass a.
cards.back: On a multilane highway, do not pass a funeral procession in the right lane unless the procession occupies the farthest-left lane.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Do not enter an intersection across a funeral.
cards.back: Do not enter an intersection across a funeral procession's path while it is passing through, regardless of the traffic signal's color.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Give funeral processions.
cards.back: Give funeral processions the right of way.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Every funeral-procession vehicle must.
cards.back: Every funeral-procession vehicle must use its headlights and taillights.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The first and last vehicles in a funeral.
cards.back: The first and last vehicles in a funeral procession must also flash warning lights to mark its endpoints.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A vehicle below normal traffic speed that delays.
cards.back: A vehicle below normal traffic speed that delays at least three vehicles in a rural area or on a two-lane highway must pull off wherever safe to let them pass.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A vehicle designed for no more than twenty-five.
cards.back: A vehicle designed for no more than twenty-five miles an hour may use public highways only from thirty minutes before sunrise to thirty minutes after sunset, except snow-removal or farm equipment on non-interstate highways with flashing lights visible for five hundred feet.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Slow-moving vehicles must have a foot brake and.
cards.back: Slow-moving vehicles must have a foot brake and turn signals and display the approved slow-vehicle emblem.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Tailgating means following too closely and.
cards.back: Tailgating means following too closely and is a common cause of crashes.

cards.front: Complete the rule: When following another car, leave.
cards.back: When following another car, leave enough space to stop when needed.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Keep the brakes in good working.
cards.back: Keep the brakes in good working condition when relying on a following gap.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Know the brakes' stopping performance in different conditions.
cards.back: Know the brakes' stopping performance in different conditions and test them often, especially on wet, icy or snowy roads.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The handbook's minimum recommended following interval is three.
cards.back: The handbook's minimum recommended following interval is three seconds, with more distance needed at high speeds or in bad weather.

cards.front: Complete the rule: For the recommended following-gap check, select a stationary.
cards.back: For the recommended following-gap check, select a stationary reference ahead of the lead vehicle, such as a tree or roadside sign.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Begin counting three seconds when the.
cards.back: Begin counting three seconds when the vehicle ahead passes the chosen object.

cards.front: Complete the rule: In the handbook's reference-object check, the interval before.
cards.back: In the handbook's reference-object check, the interval before reaching the object should be at least three seconds and several times longer in bad weather.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Maintain space around the vehicle on all.
cards.back: Maintain space around the vehicle on all sides to provide time to react to danger.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Stay near the center of the lane and.
cards.back: Stay near the center of the lane and leave enough space ahead to stop or pass safely.

cards.front: Complete the rule: If another vehicle follows too closely.
cards.back: If another vehicle follows too closely, slow down and allow it to pass.

cards.back: A left-turning driver must yield to oncoming intersection traffic unless a traffic-control device directs otherwise.

cards.back: If a traffic light fails during a power outage, apply the yielding rules of a four-way stop.
